name: crowd
prompt: Dense crowd of pedestrians seen from directly overhead on a Paris square in autumn, hundreds of people in wool coats, trench coats, scarves and berets walking in all directions, tops of heads and shoulders, some carrying bags and coffee cups, pale cobblestones visible in small gaps, overcast soft light, warm muted browns and greys. {FILM}. {EXCL}

name: privacy

name: family

name: campground

name: passport-master

name: eagle
